environment.description: Celery worker deployed in Kubernetes pod within 'batch-processing' namespace. Redis broker accessible on internal network. Tasks are enqueued by the API gateway service which accepts webhook POST requests on /api/v1/webhooks endpoint. The API gateway forwards task payloads including auth_token directly to Redis. No network policy restricts which pods can connect to Redis. Worker pod has outbound access to core-api.internal.

config.ingress: nginx-ingress with TLS termination, no client cert requirement
